description: Add new pieces to an existing asset set from generate_asset_set, drawn in the same view, style preset, style words, palette and style sheet, or (redraw_failed) redraw the pieces that failed their view check or were not cut out. For a new set in another view or style use generate_asset_set; for one loose image, generate_image. Voidless+ only; 20 credits a sheet + 10 a cut on every call (estimate_only shows the plan and price free), and a long run returns a job for check_generation. Returns each new piece's asset ID, tags and world_height (in the set's reference-character heights: give `size` on items whose size matters) and a redraw offer for any failures.

estimate_only.description: true = return only the sheet plan and the price; nothing is drawn or charged (default false)

items.description: New items for the set, 0-24, same shape as generate_asset_set's items. May be empty when redraw_failed is true

body.description: Characters: body plan (a wolf is quadruped, a slime blob, a bat flying). Omitted: guessed

kind.description: character (rotated and animated), object (a prop) or tile. Omitted: guessed from the name

name.description: What it is, e.g. 'knight', 'ice golem', 'treasure chest'

notes.description: Optional details: colours, outfit, what it holds

reference.description: This item is the set's unit of height (default: the first humanoid character)

shape.description: Optional: how it fits a cell (a tree is tall, a cart wide). Omitted: guessed

size.description: Its height in the game world, as a multiple of the set's reference character (the hero = 1): a boss golem 2.5, a slime 0.5, a door 1.2. Wins over the height the sheet draws (sheets often draw a boss barely bigger than the hero). Give it whenever relative size matters

redraw_failed.description: true = also redraw, on a small sheet in the set's style, the pieces that failed the view check or went missing (default false)

set_id.description: The set's id: generate_asset_set's set_id, which is its first sheet's asset id

name: add_to_asset_set
